title: Huanyutong Successfully Supports 2026 Brand Power China Tour Nantong Station: Smart Journey, Symbiotic Leap
subtitle: Gathering Industry Elite to Discuss Smart Security and IoT Development, Building a New Future for Industrial Ecosystem
quote: Smart technology leads the future, brands achieve dreams. Huanyutong works hand in hand with industry colleagues to create a new smart security ecosystem.
content:
On May 29, the second stop of the 2026 Brand Power China Tour national circuit successfully concluded in Nantong, Jiangsu. With the theme Smart Journey, Symbiotic Leap, this event brought together industry elites from security, IoT, and intelligentization fields across the country. Through diverse sessions such as benchmark visits, closed-door discussions, and industry chain matchmaking, an efficient platform for industry exchange and resource connection was established. As a sponsor of this event, Huanyutong participated throughout the event, exploring new industry trends and building a new symbiotic ecosystem with industry colleagues.

On May 28, the organizing committee arranged visits to two benchmark enterprises in Nantong: Jiangsu Tongcheng Environmental Industry Group Co., Ltd. and Nantong Weijiedun Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. The Huanyutong team observed cutting-edge smart products and implementation solutions, discussing future cooperation models.

Empowering symbiosis through precise matchmaking, upgrading industries with brand strength. Focusing on frontier fields such as smart security, IoT, and intelligentization, this exchange discussed industry development opportunities and implementation directions. Huanyutong engaged in deep exchanges with industry partners, showcasing solutions for smart security, smart hospitals, smart elderly care, and IoT.

The company has deeply cultivated the industry for many years, continuously refining products and solutions. Relying on technical accumulation and practical experience, we connect quality resources, deepen cross-industry cooperation, and jointly promote the construction and high-quality development of industrial ecosystems.

This trip to Nantong was fruitful and motivating. Huanyutong will continue to deeply cultivate technological innovation, refine quality products, improve implementation services, deepen collaboration with national industry chain partners, actively participate in industry ecosystem construction, empower smart security industry upgrades with core capabilities, and work with industry colleagues to achieve symbiotic leaps and start a new journey!
